candidate.title: scM&T-Seq
candidate.scope: Row-specific Illumina scM&T-Seq architecture: single-cell isolation and lysis, bead capture of polyA RNA, physical separation from genomic DNA, on-bead Smart-Seq2 transcriptome processing, scBS-seq methylome library generation, and separate sequencing/alignment of the matched fractions. The full attached crop was inspected: G&T-Seq above and partial sci-CAR below are neighboring rows, not alternative targets of this card. The left single-cell/polyA RNA/DNA cartoon explains the paired biological targets, not an additional extraction route. Smart-Seq2 and scBS-seq are embedded components, not additional method_names. The implementation is resolved to Angermueller et al., PMID 26752769; this is a compact schematic architecture, not an execution recipe.

operations.label: Streptavidin magnetic bead with mRNA capture primer
operations.description: Capture polyA RNA on the primer-bearing bead while DNA remains in the same mixture as a separate, unbound material.

operations.label: Separate the DNA and the RNA
operations.description: Physically divide the capture mixture into a bead-bound RNA fraction and a genomic DNA fraction, each retained for its own downstream processing.
operations.information_effect: This is a molecular partition within one cell, preserving a matched RNA–DNA provenance. Separation permits DNA bisulfite treatment without exposing the transcriptome to that treatment.
